title: County bus advertising rules in Bill 13
summary: Committee Report 26-33 recommending first reading of Bill 13 on county transit bus advertising came up on June 19, but the vote was not captured in the recording. On May 21 the committee approved replacing the bill with the revised Bill 13, CD1. If the law changes, the transportation department will seek proposals from advertising agencies and may return to adjust ad rates.
